server.name: sentinel-data-exploration
server.description: Microsoft Sentinel data exploration MCP surface

tools.name: sentinel.login
tools.title: Sentinel Login
tools.description: Check cached Azure CLI authentication for Sentinel. Interactive Azure sign-in occurs only when forceLogin is true. Registry proxy clients should use proxy.sign_in, which also rediscovers upstream tools.

tenant.description: Optional Azure tenant ID override for cached-token validation or interactive sign-in.

forceLogin.description: Defaults to false. When true, open interactive Azure CLI sign-in before validating Sentinel access.

tools.name: list_sentinel_workspaces
tools.title: List Sentinel Workspaces
tools.description: List the Sentinel workspaces available to the current principal.

tools.name: query_lake
tools.title: Query Sentinel Lake
tools.description: Run a KQL query against Sentinel data exploration.

tools.name: search_tables
tools.title: Search Sentinel Tables
tools.description: Search for Sentinel tables using a natural-language or keyword query.

query.description: Natural-language or keyword query describing the tables to find.
